purpose: Human-first presentation layer for the canonical Equity Uprise lab runtime. Learners begin from observable symptoms and work through diagnosis before engineering detail is progressively disclosed.

IT-LAB-008.title: The check-in computer has no internet
IT-LAB-008.role: You are the junior IT technician on duty.
IT-LAB-008.issue_report: The check-in computer was working earlier. Now it says it has no network connection.
known: The problem was reported from one workstation.
Do not change unrelated systems just to make the symptom disappear.
IT-LAB-008.goal: Find the smallest cause, make the safest repair, and prove the computer is back online.

action_labels.f1-workstation-link-validate: Confirm the computer is back online

f1-workstation-link-diagnose.label: The computer's network port is disabled
The entire building lost internet service

IT-LAB-008.success_message: Reception can use the check-in computer again, and you verified the fix instead of stopping at the first green light.

IT-LAB-017.title: The Wi-Fi on Floor 2 stopped working
IT-LAB-017.role: You are the junior IT technician responding to a user report.
IT-LAB-017.issue_report: People in the forum suddenly cannot connect to Wi-Fi. Wired systems in the room are still expected to work.
known: Start with what users can observe before opening an engineering view.
A wireless access point needs both a network link and power.
IT-LAB-017.goal: Determine why the local Wi-Fi disappeared, restore it safely, and verify clients can reconnect.

reinforcement.title: Got WiFi?
reinforcement.purpose: Use after the ticket as a PRIM3 refresher for wireless, RF, encryption and Layer 1/2 concepts.

action_labels.f2-wifi-inspect-1: Check the nearby Wi-Fi access point
action_labels.f2-wifi-inspect-2: Check whether the access point still has a network path

f2-wifi-diagnose.label: The access point lost its network / PoE link
The DNS service failed for the whole building
A user typed the wrong password

IT-LAB-017.success_message: Floor 2 Wi-Fi is available again. The repair addressed the access point path without changing unrelated network services.

IT-LAB-016.title: The interview-room phone will not connect
IT-LAB-016.role: You are supporting a staff member before an interview.
IT-LAB-016.issue_report: The desk phone has power, but it will not register for calls.
known: Power alone does not prove the phone is on the correct voice network.
Avoid broad network changes when one endpoint is affected.
IT-LAB-016.goal: Find why the phone cannot register, repair the assignment, and verify calling service returns.

f3-voice-vlan-diagnose.label: The phone is assigned to the wrong voice network

IT-LAB-016.success_message: The phone registers again and the change stayed limited to the affected voice path.

IT-LAB-030.title: The forum video is flooding the network
IT-LAB-030.role: You are helping the event team stabilize the room before a live session.
IT-LAB-030.issue_report: Video traffic is spilling across the room network and other devices are becoming unreliable.
known: The cameras and AV controller are still present.
The problem affects how multicast traffic is being handled.
IT-LAB-030.goal: Inspect the AV path, identify the network-control problem, correct it, and verify delivery is constrained again.
IT-LAB-030.success_message: The forum AV traffic is constrained again and unrelated devices are no longer being flooded.

IT-LAB-031.title: The media floor video is choppy
IT-LAB-031.role: You are supporting a media-production session.
IT-LAB-031.issue_report: The video path is showing loss and jitter even though the endpoints are still online.
known: This is a quality problem, not a total outage.
Compare the capture and control path before changing anything.
IT-LAB-031.goal: Find why real-time media lost priority, restore the expected treatment, and verify smooth delivery.

action_labels.f4-av-qos-validate: Confirm the media path is stable

f4-av-qos-diagnose.label: Real-time traffic lost its QoS protection
The building lost all network power
The phone is on the wrong VLAN

IT-LAB-031.success_message: The production path is stable again and the fix targeted traffic handling rather than masking the symptom.

IT-LAB-009.title: A research computer is on the wrong network
IT-LAB-009.role: You are supporting a policy/research workstation.
IT-LAB-009.issue_report: The computer is connected, but it is reaching the wrong network resources.
known: Connectivity by itself is not proof of correct segmentation.
Do not broaden access as a shortcut.
IT-LAB-009.goal: Identify the assignment mismatch, restore the intended network, and verify appropriate access.

action_labels.f5-workstation-vlan-inspect-1: Check the affected computer's network assignment

f5-workstation-vlan-diagnose.label: The computer is assigned to the wrong VLAN

IT-LAB-009.success_message: The research workstation is back on the intended network without broadening permissions.

IT-LAB-025.title: A command-floor camera stopped sending video
IT-LAB-025.role: You are troubleshooting a building security video problem.
IT-LAB-025.issue_report: One camera no longer reaches the video system.
known: A camera depends on power, network connectivity and the recording service.
Start at the symptom and follow the dependency chain.
IT-LAB-025.goal: Trace the broken path, restore the simulated link, and verify video reaches the recorder again.

f6-camera-vms-diagnose.label: The camera's network path is down
The AV system is flooding multicast

IT-LAB-025.success_message: The camera feed is restored to the video system and the dependency path has been verified.

IT-LAB-027.title: The rooftop controls stopped reporting
IT-LAB-027.role: You are supporting building operations in a training sandbox.
IT-LAB-027.issue_report: Roof equipment is still physically present, but its building-control telemetry disappeared.
known: The controller and its sensor chain are related.
This is a simulation; never infer permission to operate a real BAS from this lab.
IT-LAB-027.goal: Trace the control problem, restore the simulated controller, and verify telemetry returns.

f7-bas-diagnose.label: A research workstation is on the wrong VLAN

IT-LAB-027.success_message: Rooftop telemetry is back in the sandbox and the repair stayed inside the building-control simulation.

IT-LAB-032.title: The network closet suddenly went dark
IT-LAB-032.role: You are responding to a building-wide support escalation.
IT-LAB-032.issue_report: Equipment served by a basement network closet dropped offline at the same time.
known: Several devices failing together can point to a shared dependency.
Check power before treating each endpoint as an unrelated failure.
IT-LAB-032.goal: Trace the shared power dependency, restore the simulated path, and verify network equipment recovers.

action_labels.b1-idf-power-inspect-1: Check the network closet backup power

b1-idf-power-diagnose.label: One user entered the wrong password
A camera lost its lens cover

IT-LAB-032.success_message: The shared network equipment is back because you repaired the common power dependency instead of treating every endpoint separately.

IT-LAB-010.title: Everyone on the media floor lost network access
IT-LAB-010.role: You are the technician handling a floor-wide outage.
IT-LAB-010.issue_report: Multiple devices on Floor 4 lost connectivity at the same time.
known: A floor-wide symptom usually deserves a shared-path check before endpoint-by-endpoint repair.
The basement core is a dependency of the floor access network.
IT-LAB-010.goal: Identify the broken uplink, restore the simulated path, and verify floor service returns.

xf-f4-uplink-diagnose.label: The floor's uplink to the core is down
One desk phone is on the wrong VLAN

IT-LAB-010.success_message: Floor 4 connectivity is back and the evidence points to the repaired shared uplink.

IT-LAB-033.title: An upper-floor backbone link was cut
IT-LAB-033.role: You are investigating a building backbone incident.
IT-LAB-033.issue_report: The upper building is showing a backbone-path failure, but redundancy may still be carrying some traffic.
known: Do not assume an outage is total just because one path failed.
Verify alternate-path behavior before and after restoration.
IT-LAB-033.goal: Locate the affected fiber path, restore it in the sandbox, and verify normal redundancy returns.

xf-f6-fiber-diagnose.label: One backbone fiber uplink was cut

IT-LAB-033.success_message: The backbone path is restored and redundancy is back to the modeled baseline.
